main_text.p: homine genite, homi-nibus genite, da mihi vera, da recta scribere, tibi in honorem, Cruci in splendorem, nobis in fructum. Materies & ordo mei operis iste. Quid Crux, & Cujusmodi fuerit: Ubi, Quare, Quo-modo, & Quatenus usurpata. Hæc omnia non distinctè solùm, sed diffusè dicam: nec displicebit accuratio illi, cui salutare hoc signum placebit.

page.notes: Running head shown as "DE CRVCE" with the printed "2" at left; the first word "homine" begins the page as a fragment of a sentence. Page furniture "CAP." is a chapter-end mark, set as a paragraph. Some letters in the running head are spaced capitals; the "E" at the end of the head is printed as "E" with a ligature-like form.
